scripts.codegen:dev: ENV=dev node -e 'import("dotenv").then(({default: d}) => d.config({path: ".env.dev"})).then(() => import("child_process")).then(({execSync}) => execSync(`npx playwright codegen --http-credentials=${process.env.BASIC_AUTH_USER}:${process.env.BASIC_AUTH_PASS} ${process.env.UI_BASE_URL}/sign-in`, {stdio: "inherit"}))'
scripts.codegen:stg: ENV=staging node -e 'import("dotenv").then(({default: d}) => d.config({path: ".env.staging"})).then(() => import("child_process")).then(({execSync}) => execSync(`npx playwright codegen --http-credentials=${process.env.BASIC_AUTH_USER}:${process.env.BASIC_AUTH_PASS} ${process.env.UI_BASE_URL}/sign-in`, {stdio: "inherit"}))'
